import numpy as np

def compute_bertscore(generated, reference, embeddings):
    gen_tokens = generated.lower().split()
    ref_tokens = reference.lower().split()
    gen_emb = np.array([embeddings.get(t, np.zeros(768)) for t in gen_tokens])
    ref_emb = np.array([embeddings.get(t, np.zeros(768)) for t in ref_tokens])
    norm_gen = np.linalg.norm(gen_emb, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    norm_ref = np.linalg.norm(ref_emb, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    sim = (gen_emb @ ref_emb.T) / (norm_gen * norm_ref.T + 1e-10)
    precision = np.mean(np.max(sim, axis=1))
    recall = np.mean(np.max(sim, axis=0))
    f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall + 1e-10)
    return precision, recall, f1
